name: Maged Gadalla
headline: Building immersive experiences, real-time systems, and interactive worlds.
about: Senior Unity & XR (VR/AR/MR) Software Engineer with over 4 years of professional expertise in designing, architecting, and deploying complex interactive simulations, real-time networking systems, and multiplayer games. Advanced proficiency in C#, computational design patterns, and cross-platform XR hardware performance optimization. Expert in implementing clean code principles, establishing robust software architecture, and leading engineering workflows within Agile/Scrum environments to deliver scalable, enterprise-grade spatial computing applications.
